occurrences.checkable_against: Text of New York City's Click-to-Cancel Rule
occurrences.quote_span: Present clear material terms of any subscription service, including a description of the product or service subject to renewal, the costs that will be charged, the frequency of charges, the deadline by date or frequency by which the consumer must act to prevent or stop further charges and cancellation mechanisms.

occurrences.subject: New York City Click-to-Cancel Rule

occurrences.quote_span: If a subscription offer includes a free gift or trial, or the price is temporary, the offer must clearly explain how and when the price will change and what will be charged, the rule states.
